'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Steve Skilton LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Skilton]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Username:''' punkrockstove
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
